office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Kevin Peck is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge appointed in 2019 and elected in 2020 and 2022, previously a King County trial lawyer and longtime judge pro tem, per his pamphlet statement.
highlights: Reports 25+ years as a District Court judge pro tem before appointment [S1]
Prior practice in employment discrimination, civil rights, and federal criminal cases [S1]
